_nota: Notas del Archivo Sonoro en inglés, por slug. Si una entrada no tiene traducción acá, la versión en inglés muestra la ficha sin nota y el build la lista en consola.
nils-frahm-ambre: From Wintermusik (Sonic Pieces, 2009), a set of piano miniatures Nils Frahm recorded before his larger studio work.
helios-bless-this-morning-year: From Eingya (Type Records, 2006), the second album by Helios, Keith Kenniff's electronic and acoustic project.
erik-satie-gnossienne-no-1: Piano piece composed in 1890. Satie left out time signatures and bar lines in the original manuscript.
alva-noto-ryuichi-sakamoto-uoon-i: From Vrioon (Raster-Noton, 2002), the first joint album by Ryuichi Sakamoto and Alva Noto: processed piano and minimal electronics.
jorge-lopez-ruiz-la-ciudad-vacia-primer-: Opening of Bronca Buenos Aires (1970), an Argentine jazz suite composed and conducted by Jorge López Ruiz.
jon-hopkins-abandon-window: Closing track of Immunity (Domino, 2013), Jon Hopkins's third album, and an acoustic counterpoint to its electronic architecture.
basic-channel-phylyps-trak: A 1993 twelve-inch on Basic Channel, one of the first releases on Moritz von Oswald and Mark Ernestus's label.
talk-talk-new-grass: From Laughing Stock (1991), Talk Talk's last recording: open sessions, acoustic arrangements and Mark Hollis's production.
maurizio-m4: Part of Maurizio's M series, released on Chain Reaction in 1995. Dub techno by Moritz von Oswald and Mark Ernestus.
deepchord-vantage-isle: From Vantage Isle Sessions (2007), Rod Modell's project as Deepchord: ambient dub built from layers of delay.
the-field-over-the-ice: From From Here We Go Sublime (Kompakt, 2007), Axel Willner's debut as The Field, built from sampled loops.
gas-pop-4: From Pop (Mille Plateaux, 2000), the fourth GAS album: Wolfgang Voigt crosses a 4/4 pulse with warped orchestral samples.
william-basinski-dlp-1-1: The first piece of The Disintegration Loops: tapes of melodies recorded in the 80s that decay as they play.
stars-of-the-lid-requiem-for-dying-mothe: From The Tired Sounds of Stars of the Lid (Kranky, 2001), Brian McBride and Adam Wiltzie's duo for strings and drones.
loscil-endless-falls: Title track of Endless Falls (Kranky, 2010), Scott Morgan's album mixing electronics, acoustic instruments and field sound.
aphex-twin-xtal: From Selected Ambient Works 85-92 (1992), early Richard D. James recordings released between Apollo and R&S.
hiroshi-yoshimura-green: From Green (Air Records, 1986), Hiroshi Yoshimura's environmental music for home listening and architectural space.
pharoah-sanders-the-creator-has-a-master: From Karma (Impulse!, 1969), Pharoah Sanders's suite with Leon Thomas; a cornerstone of spiritual jazz.
harold-budd-the-pearl: From the 1984 album with Brian Eno on Editions EG, produced with Daniel Lanois: piano, treatment and space.
tycho-a-walk: From Dive (Ghostly International, 2011), Scott Hansen's album of guitars, analog synths and programming.
bing-ruth-starwood-choker: From No Home of the Mind (4AD, 2017), Bing & Ruth's first record on 4AD, built around David Moore's piano.
fennesz-caecilia: From Endless Summer (Mego, 2001), Christian Fennesz's record of electric guitar run through the computer and digital distortion.
can-future-days: Title track of the 1973 album. Can's last recording with Damo Suzuki on vocals.
harmonia-sehr-kosmisch: From Musik von Harmonia (Brain, 1974), the trio of Hans-Joachim Roedelius, Dieter Moebius and Michael Rother.
bill-evans-peace-piece: Recorded during the Everybody Digs Bill Evans session (Riverside, 1958): a solo improvisation over a two-chord ostinato.
boards-of-canada-dayvan-cowboy: From The Campfire Headphase (Warp, 2005), the album where Michael Sandison and Marcus Eoin bring more guitars into their sound.
a-winged-victory-for-the-sullen-steep-hi: From the 2011 debut on Erased Tapes, a collaboration between Adam Wiltzie and Dustin O'Halloran across strings, piano and ambient treatment.
enrique-villegas-variaciones-sobre-cuerp: From En Cuerpo y Alma (1966), Enrique Villegas's take on the standard Body and Soul, from Argentine jazz piano.
brian-eno-an-ending-ascent: From Apollo: Atmospheres and Soundtracks (1983), composed by Brian Eno with Daniel Lanois and Roger Eno for the lunar documentary For All Mankind.
ryuichi-sakamoto-bibo-no-aozora-instrume: Instrumental version of a Sakamoto composition first released on Smoochy (1995), built on piano and strings. Years later it scored Babel (2006).
king-tubby-dub-from-the-roots: From the 1974 album produced by Bunny Lee: King Tubby mixes where echo, reverb and bass rebuild the original riddims.
rodolfo-alchourron-stadium: From Parábola (1980), by Argentine guitarist and composer Rodolfo Alchourrón, between contemporary jazz and chamber writing.
real-estate-green-aisles: From Days (Domino, 2011), Real Estate's second album, recorded with Kevin McMahon at Marcata Recording.
biosphere-kobresia: From Substrata (All Good, 1997), Geir Jenssen's second album as Biosphere: ambient built from field recordings and sampling.
jan-jelinek-do-dekor: From Loop-Finding-Jazz-Records (~scape, 2001): micro-loops pulled from jazz records and processed until the source disappears.
